title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Genesis 32: Jacob prepares to meet Esau, sends a present and wrestles at the Jabbok.

questions.text: What did Jacob call the place where the angels of God met him?
questions.explanation: When Jacob saw the angels of God, he said, "This is God's army," and he called the place Mahanaim.

questions.text: How many men did the messengers say were coming with Esau?
questions.explanation: The messengers said, "He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."

questions.text: What did Jacob do when he became greatly afraid?
questions.explanation: Jacob divided the people, flocks, herds and camels into two companies, so that one could escape if Esau struck the other.

answers.text: He divided his people and animals into two companies
He sent his wives and children back to Laban
He hid everyone in a cave in the mountain
He armed his servants and prepared for battle

questions.text: What did Jacob say he had with him when he crossed over the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Jacob prayed, "With just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies."

questions.text: In his prayer, what did Jacob remind God he had promised to make his offspring like?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "You said, 'I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea.'"

questions.text: Which of these was part of the present Jacob sent to Esau?
questions.explanation: The present included goats, ewes, rams, thirty milk camels and their colts, cows, bulls and donkeys.

answers.text: Thirty milk camels and their colts
A hundred oxen and their calves
Three hundred lambs of the first year

questions.text: Which ford did Jacob cross at night with his wives, servants and sons?
questions.explanation: He rose up that night, took his two wives, his two servants and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

questions.text: What new name did the man give Jacob?
questions.explanation: The man said, "Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed."

questions.text: Why did Jacob call the place Peniel?
questions.explanation: Jacob called the place Peniel, for he said, "I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved."

answers.text: The angels of God had met him there
He had made a covenant there
He had seen God face to face and lived

questions.text: What do the children of Israel not eat "to this day" because of this event?
questions.explanation: The children of Israel don't eat the sinew of the hip, because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew of the hip.
